name: com.nexstead.enginebench
description: A physical engine and exhaust sound simulator for the Unity Editor, based on engine-sim by Ange Yaghi. Make engines from 27 presets, tune their sound, and listen to them live in the Editor. The simulation is a C# port, bit-identical to the original, and runs in real time with Burst. A render API and Bench extensions let other tools build on it. Editor only: nothing goes into player builds.

samples.description: A scene that plays the small-block V8 preset in Play Mode through an EngineAudioSource: it starts on its own, and Space gives full throttle. Window > Nx Engine Bench is where engines are picked, designed and tuned.
